title: intake-profile

schemaVersion.description: Schema version this document conforms to (semver).

type.description: Profile archetype, e.g. field-data-collection, saas, enterprise-tool.

client_count.description: Number of distinct client organizations served.

annual_records.description: Expected records created per year (sizing signal).

roles.description: Distinct user roles, e.g. volunteer, coordinator, admin.

offline_required.description: Whether the app must function offline (drives offline plugins).

has_pii.description: Whether the app stores personally identifiable information.

has_protected_geo.description: Whether the app stores location data that must be protected (e.g. endangered species sites).

has_money_transactions.description: Whether the app handles payments or money movement.

data_provenance_critical.description: Whether an auditable, append-only record of data provenance is required.

ops_capacity.description: How much operational capacity the owner has to run the system.

description: Structured, pre-calibration facts about an application, produced by the Intake layer.
